description: Everything the registry knows for one New York place (county, one of the 62 cities, an NYC borough, or a region): its own portal(s), sources for cities inside it, regional sources, and statewide sources that cover it. Says plainly whether the place has a portal, was checked and has none ('no-portal-exists'), or is not in the registry ('not-in-registry', which means unchecked, not absent).

include_statewide.description: List the statewide sources too (default true)

limit.description: Most rows in each list (own, within, regional, statewide). Default 25

name: list_sources_for_place
